title: Holidays in Two Countries
text:
Many people celebrate holidays in different countries. In Mexico, families have a big party for Day of the Dead. They make food and put flowers on the tables. The flowers are often orange.

In Japan, families celebrate Children's Day in May. Many families fly colorful fish kites in the sky. The kites look like big fish. Children are happy on this day.

questions.text: What do families put on the tables in Mexico?
What do many families fly in Japan?
How do you think the families feel during their holidays?
Which sentence best describes holidays in this passage?
options: They are special days for families
They are days with no food
They are days for school tests

vocabulary.definition: groups of people who live together, such as parents and children
the colorful parts of a plant
toys that fly in the wind on a string
to do something special for a happy day

paragraph_translations: Muchas personas celebran fiestas en diferentes países. En México, las familias tienen una gran fiesta para el Día de los Muertos. Preparan comida y ponen flores en las mesas. Las flores suelen ser naranjas.

En Japón, las familias celebran el Día de los Niños en mayo. Muchas familias vuelan cometas de colores con forma de peces en el cielo. Las cometas parecen peces grandes. Los niños están felices en este día.
